name: Potyond (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Potyond: a crowned red and green shield with a yellow lion and a plough, above a green scroll inscribed POTYOND.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Potyond arms with crown and scroll
